out_basename.description: Root name for the output JBIG2 file.

duplicate_line_removal.description: Enable TPGD in generic region coder for duplicate line removal.

pdf_output.description: Produce data ready for PDF embedding.

symbol_mode.description: Use text region coder (symbol mode) instead of generic coder.

classification_threshold.description: Classification threshold for the symbol coder (0.0 to 1.0).

classification_weight.description: Classification weight for the symbol coder (0.0 to 1.0).

use_global_threshold.description: Use global BW threshold on 8 bpp images instead of local adaptive thresholding.

use_refinement.description: Use refinement for lossless encoding (requires symbol mode).

output_png.description: Path to dump the thresholded image as a PNG file.

upsample_2x.description: Upsample input image by 2x before thresholding.

upsample_4x.description: Upsample input image by 4x before thresholding.

separate_images.description: Separate images from mixed input and save them individually.

jpeg_output.description: Write images from mixed input as JPEG files.

auto_thresh.description: Use automatic thresholding in the symbol encoder.

force_dpi.description: Force the DPI setting for the output image.

no_hash.description: Disable the use of hash functions for automatic thresholding.

input_files.description: List of input image filenames to encode.
